controls.input_condition: An HSE report, target or monitoring row carries a scheme year
controls.expected_action: Interpret the scheme year as 1 January through 31 December and store publication/submission dates separately
controls.risk_prevented: Mixing reporting year with publication or submission year

controls.input_condition: Previous-year HSE emissions are being promoted as compliant reported values
controls.expected_action: Require annual emissions report plus declaration or verification report submitted through METS by 31 March
controls.risk_prevented: Treating draft or late data as formally submitted compliance data

controls.input_condition: An annual HSE emissions total is calculated
controls.expected_action: Require monitored reportable emissions covering 1 January to 31 December under the approved monitoring plan
controls.risk_prevented: Partial-year totals presented as annual emissions

controls.input_condition: An HSE annual report has assurance metadata
controls.expected_action: Record either operator declaration or independent verification as the assurance mode; never infer one from the other

controls.input_condition: Evidence supports an HSE annual report
controls.expected_action: Retain source activity data, calculations, declaration or verification and monitoring-plan evidence for at least 10 years from submission

controls.input_condition: A temporary monitoring methodology change is required
controls.expected_action: Store the change and notification date; require regulator notice 14 days before, or as soon as reasonably practicable when advance notice is impossible

controls.input_condition: Small-emitter reportable emissions exceed 24,999 tCO2e in a scheme year
controls.expected_action: Flag HSE threshold exceedance and require regulator notification by 31 March of the following year
controls.risk_prevented: Retaining invalid HSE status without escalation

controls.input_condition: Reportable emissions exceed the annual HSE target
controls.expected_action: Calculate target excess separately and record the mandatory penalty basis as excess emissions multiplied by the applicable carbon price
controls.risk_prevented: Applying penalty to total emissions or hiding target breach

controls.input_condition: An HSE target is based on estimated emissions
controls.expected_action: Set bankable amount to zero and preserve estimated_target=true
controls.risk_prevented: Creating future target headroom from an estimated baseline

controls.input_condition: A 2025 bankable amount is considered for a 2026 target
controls.expected_action: Reject cross-allocation-period banking; keep bankable amounts within their applicable period
controls.risk_prevented: Carrying obsolete target credits into a new period

controls.input_condition: An annual emissions report is returned by a verifier or saved in METS
controls.expected_action: Do not mark submitted until the operator completes the final submission step to the regulator in METS
controls.risk_prevented: Confusing prepared or verified reports with formally submitted reports

controls.input_condition: A verified annual emissions report is amended before regulator submission
controls.expected_action: Require re-submission to the independent verifier before final regulator submission
controls.risk_prevented: Submitting values not covered by the verification opinion

controls.input_condition: A facility or pollutant is absent from PRTR rows
controls.expected_action: Classify as not reported or below applicable threshold unless an explicit zero release is proven
controls.risk_prevented: Converting reporting-threshold absence into zero emissions

controls.input_condition: The same pollutant is assessed for air, water and land releases
controls.expected_action: Apply the threshold and value independently for each receiving medium
controls.risk_prevented: Using an air threshold or value for water or land

controls.input_condition: A PRTR record describes off-site waste or wastewater transfer
controls.expected_action: Store transfer type, destination and quantity separately from on-site release-to-medium fields
controls.risk_prevented: Counting transferred material as a direct environmental release

controls.input_condition: A UK ETS compliance report contains emissions and surrendered allowance fields
controls.expected_action: Keep verified emissions and surrendered UK allowances as separate measures and derive compliance balance explicitly
controls.risk_prevented: Treating surrendered allowances as physical emissions
